extDescription.message: Global shortcuts for transcribers: pause with rewind, skip, speed and timestamps for the audio/video playing in a tab.

shortcutsGlobalHint.message: To use them while typing in another window, choose “Global” next to each shortcut.

shortcutsStep2.message: Assign a key combination to each action; the speed actions start unassigned.

shortcutsStep3.message: In each shortcut's drop-down choose “Global” to use it from Word, Docs or any other window.

shortcutsConflictHint.message: Chrome only suggests Ctrl+Shift+0–9 as global shortcuts, and at most four. A global shortcut captures the key combination system-wide: avoid the ones your editor uses (Google Docs uses Ctrl+Shift+7/8/9 for lists).

popupTargetNone.message: None yet. Enable the site and play some audio or video.

popupTargetNoAccessTitle.message: Tab on a site that is not enabled

errorNoTarget.message: No tab with audio or video.

errorNoAccess.message: No access to this site: enable it below.

errorNoMedia.message: No audio or video found in the tab.

errorPlayBlocked.message: The browser blocked playback: click once on the page.

errorGeneric.message: The action could not be completed.

popupSiteUnsupported.message: Chrome does not allow extensions on this page (chrome://, Chrome Web Store, PDF viewer).

popupEmbeddedHint.message: This page embeds content from other sites. If the player lives in one of them, enable it too:

privacyShort.message: No network, no analytics: everything stays on your computer.

optionsRewindOnPauseHint.message: When pausing with the shortcut or the popup, jump back this many seconds so you resume with context (like Express Scribe). Pausing from the page itself does not rewind.

optionsSpeedHint.message: Speed changes in 0.1× steps between 0.5× and 2×.

optionsOverlay.message: Show a brief indicator on the page when a shortcut is used

optionsSitesHint.message: ScribeKeys can only see and control media on these sites. To add one, open it and click “Enable on this site” in the popup.

optionsSitesEmpty.message: You have not enabled any site yet.

optionsPrivacyText.message: ScribeKeys makes no network requests, has no analytics and does not read page content: it only interacts with the audio and video elements of the sites you enable. Settings are stored in chrome.storage.sync (synced with your Chrome account if sync is on).
